cases.request: local check with trusted intent
cases.expected: does not connect to HGUET Cloud

cases.request: valid enrolled device with required group and ML-DSA-87 certificates
cases.expected: may connect after proven TLS interop

cases.request: classical-only TLS, or no ML-DSA-87 cert under PQ_REQUIRED
cases.expected: TLS rejects; no fallback

cases.request: unenrolled client with pinned PQ-authenticated server
cases.expected: enrollment only; check requires mTLS

cases.request: metadata scope with digest and subjects, no raw tx
cases.expected: Cloud cannot claim to simulate transaction or independently verify payment intent

cases.request: transaction bytes with consent false
cases.expected: reject without paid analysis and no data egress

cases.request: local hard DENY and Cloud says no known threats
cases.expected: final CLI verdict DENY

cases.request: CloudAssessment signed body modified
cases.expected: reject Cloud evidence, UNKNOWN if mandatory

cases.request: strict profile requires Cloud and service unavailable
cases.expected: block, no local ALLOW

cases.request: Cloud optional and service unavailable
cases.expected: explicit local-only coverage, no Cloud claim

cases.request: two simultaneous requests same tenant/request ID/body
cases.expected: same terminal result and at most one charge

cases.request: same tenant/request ID but changed payload
cases.expected: idempotency conflict without second charge

cases.request: other tenant queries same request ID
cases.expected: cannot retrieve first tenant's report, invoice or balance

cases.request: CheckReceipt accepted, CheckResult not terminal
cases.expected: CLI does not emit ALLOW based on receipt

cases.request: valid CloudAssessment and invalid BillingReceipt
cases.expected: risk result and billing receipt validation fail independently

cases.request: invoice paid with incorrect mint, program or network
cases.expected: no service credit

cases.request: same finalized chain transfer observed twice
cases.expected: exactly one service credit

cases.request: mandatory unsupported token semantics
cases.expected: UNKNOWN rather than ALLOW, no override by Cloud

cases.request: Solana transaction format v1 with inline addresses and fixed config
cases.expected: parse according to current v1 format or explicit UNKNOWN if unsupported

cases.request: Cloud check references an expired or wrong capability quote
cases.expected: reject before reservation and do not charge

cases.request: server quoted price above CLI configured max credit-unit fee
cases.expected: fail before check, do not silently accept revised price

cases.request: CloudAssessment missing source evidence digest or altered source provenance
cases.expected: reject missing required fields; signature verification fails if sourced evidence changes
